1.web: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
1.asv: And of the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

2.web: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations: their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
2.asv: And the sons of Tola: Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, to wit, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations: their number in the days of David was two and twenty thousand and six hundred.

3.web: The sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.
3.asv: And the sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah. And the sons of Izrahiah: Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.

4.web: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.
4.asv: And with them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the host for war, six and thirty thousand; for they had many wives and sons.

5.web: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, reckoned in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.
5.asv: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, reckoned in all by genealogy, were fourscore and seven thousand.

6.web: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
6.asv: The sons ofBenjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

7.web: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were reckoned by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.
7.asv: And the sons of Bela: Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were reckoned by genealogy twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.

8.web: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jeremoth, and Abijah, and Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
8.asv: And the sons of Becher: Zemirah, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jeremoth, and Abijah, and Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

9.web: They were reckoned by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.
9.asv: And they were reckoned by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand and two hundred.

10.web: The sons of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
10.asv: And the sons of Jediael: Bilhan. And the sons of Bilhan: Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

11.web: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand and two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.
11.asv: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand and two hundred, that were able to go forth in the host for war.

12.web: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, the sons of Aher.
12.asv: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, the sons of Aher.

13.web: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
13.asv: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

14.web: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore: she bore Machir the father of Gilead:
14.asv: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bare; she bare Machir the father of Gilead.

15.web: and Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah; and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
15.asv: And Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah; and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.

16.web: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
16.asv: And Maacah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

17.web: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
17.asv: And the sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

18.web: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, and Abiezer, and Mahlah.
18.asv: And his sister Hammolecheth bare Ishhod, and Abiezer, and Mahlah.

19.web: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
19.asv: And the sons of Shemida were Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.

20.web: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eleadah his son, and Tahath his son,
20.asv: And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eleadah his son, and Tahath his son,

21.web: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.
21.asv: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in the land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.

22.web: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
22.asv: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

23.web: He went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
23.asv: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.

24.web: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.
24.asv: And his daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth-horon the nether and the upper, and Uzzen-sheerah.

25.web: Rephah was his son, and Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
25.asv: And Rephah was his son, and Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,

26.web: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
26.asv: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

27.web: Nun his son, Joshua his son.
27.asv: Nun his son, Joshua his son.

28.web: Their possessions and habitations were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;
28.asv: And their possessions and habitations were Beth-el and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Azzah and the towns thereof;

29.web: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. In these lived the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
29.asv: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.

30.web: The sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishvah, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
30.asv: The sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishvah, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.

31.web: The sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
31.asv: And the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

32.web: Heber became the father of Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
32.asv: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.

33.web: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
33.asv: And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

34.web: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
34.asv: And the sons of Shemer: Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

35.web: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
35.asv: And the sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.

36.web: The sons of Zophah: Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
36.asv: The sons of Zophah: Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,

37.web: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
37.asv: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.

38.web: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, and Pispa, and Ara.
38.asv: And the sons of Jether: Jephunneh, and Pispa, and Ara.

39.web: The sons of Ulla: Arah, and Hanniel, and Rizia.
39.asv: And the sons of Ulla: Arah, and Hanniel, and Rizia.

40.web: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them reckoned by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.
40.asv: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. And the number of them reckoned by genealogy for service in war was twenty and six thousand men.
